blocks.text: These terms apply to every order placed with Brindlewood Supply Co. Please read them carefully.
1. Orders. An order is accepted only when we confirm it in writing or ship the goods. We may decline any order for any reason.
2. Prices. Prices are those in effect on the date of shipment and exclude tax, freight and insurance, which we will add to the invoice.
3. Payment. Payment is due within thirty days of the invoice date. We may suspend shipments while any amount is overdue.
4. Delivery. Delivery dates are estimates only. Risk of loss passes to you when the goods leave our warehouse.
5. Returns. You may return unused goods within fourteen days with our prior authorization. A restocking fee of ten percent applies.
6. Warranty. We warrant that goods will conform to their published specifications for twelve months from the date of delivery.
7. Liability. Our total liability for any claim will not exceed the price paid for the goods that gave rise to that claim.
8. Force Majeure. Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including strikes, fire and flood.
9. Governing Law. These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Ohio, excluding its conflict of laws rules.
Questions about these terms? Contact your account manager or the sales office.
